question: Can a newly source-authenticated public native EMC organoid measurement support a useful new controlled empirical comparison?
finding: The newly recovered gelatin study provides three patient methods labels for liposarcoma/liposarcoma/leiomyosarcoma plus a separate liposarcoma cell line, not an eligible native EMC measurement. The second source remains inaccessible before its donor/assay roster.
value: There is no new source-linked native EMC measurement or defensible unanswered comparison here; retrieving an organoid source is supporting evidence rather than a finding.
numerical_stage: OFF; no response/gene matrix, OCR outcome, stain/Western results or new computation
strongest_limits: r-PDOX histology/conditions unknown through tested route
Gelatin public named TableS1 uninspected after timeout
Older and remaining public candidate rosters pending; no campaign exhaustion
Incidental non-EMC clinical narrative exposure recorded and excluded; no blinding claim
reopen: Actual source-authenticated native EMC donor/condition map plus public processed phenotypic or perturbation measurement and compatible controls could justify a new exact before-value question, independent assay/value challenge and root review.
